title: Products of the SiN and isoprene single-collision reaction
difficulty_reasons: The source studies which SiNC5H7 products and formation mechanisms are consistent with crossed-beam SiN + isoprene scattering. The task retains that gas-phase reaction and its energetic experimental constraints.
Select physically admissible product candidates and how to discover or eliminate them.
